entry.title: Chokepoint Geometries in Sub-2nm EUV Lithography and High-Bandwidth Memory Supply Chains
entry.summary:
Export control regimes targeting final AI accelerator FLOPS/mm² overlook upstream chemical precursor, photo-acid generator, and advanced packaging (CoWoS-L) single-point dependencies. Input-output network modeling across 140 fabrication tiers shows that wafer-level metrology and EUV pellicle bottlenecks constrain frontier cluster deployment $3.2\times$ more tightly than fab tool embargoes.

Source: CSIS / Foreign Affairs · Tags: #tech-policy #geopolitics #semiconductors

entry.title: Attritional Cost-Exchange Ratios of Autonomous Loitering Swarms Versus Multi-Layered Air Defense
entry.summary:
Interceptor-to-target unit cost ratios exceeding $25:1$ create structural magazine-depth exhaustion under saturation salvos. Quantitative salvos modeling demonstrates that integrating directed-energy short-range defense with low-cost acoustic/RF sensor meshes restores positive cost-exchange equilibrium at engagement densities up to $180\text{ tracks/min}$.

Source: War on the Rocks / SIPRI · Tags: #defense-strategy #geopolitics

entry.title: Subsea HVDC Interconnectors, Critical Mineral Corridors, and Middle-Corridor Grid Sovereignty
entry.summary:
Cross-continental HVDC power cables and rare-earth refining corridors across the Black Sea, Caucasus, and Eastern Mediterranean are reshaping regional deterrence. Game-theoretic bargaining analysis shows that multi-nodal transit hubs reduce single-supplier coercion leverage by $54\%$ under winter peak-load stress scenarios.

Source: ECFR / EDAM Strategic Assessment · Tags: #energy-security #geopolitics #international-law
